title: Recommendation
description: Signals are SEPARATE. None is a relationship-success probability. Unknown values are null with an explicit status.

compatibility.description: score (raw alignment 0-100), confidence (evidence 0-100), adjusted_score (shrunk toward 50), categories, components

location.description: distance_km, location_score, location_confidence, location_available, location_status in {known, partial_unknown, unknown, unresolved, coarse, disabled}, preferred/max distance flags

preferences.description: score, confidence, status in {known, no_preferences, unknown}, per-criterion matches

behavior.description: score|null, confidence, status in {cold_start, insufficient_data, sufficient_data, no_applicable_evidence, disabled}, evidence_count

mutual_interest.description: probability|null, confidence, status in {available, insufficient_behavioral_data, disabled}

ranking.description: final_score and per-signal components with effective weights (placeholders, not validated)
